lineHeightExceptions.reason: The inherited 14px/20px secondary-text family preserves its reviewed 20px line height on Site's 8px baseline.

visualEvidence.singleLine: One 20px line plus one 8px nudge-and-compensation unit occupies 28px (3.5 baselines) and exits on the 4px half-phase.
visualEvidence.multiline: Successive 20px lines advance by 2.5 baselines, alternate between the primary and half phase, and return to the primary phase every second line.
